messages:
Priya S (CS): Heads up — we just pulled the list of tenants affected by the "activation window" (bulk onboarding) failure overnight. ~42 trial customers and 7 renewals had partial indexing, some missed demo slots. Need a short customer-facing status + mitigations and an RCA ETA.
Jamal R (Account Exec): Oof. Which renewals? any enterprise deals at risk?
Priya S (CS): Two renewals in advanced discussions (ACME Corp, BlueShift). Both had indexing stuck at 0/3 uploads. I've DM'd account owners.
Elena K (Support): Root cause looks tied to the new rate limiter config we rolled at 02:10 UTC — background reindex jobs exceeded token bucket and were throttled; the retry logic didn't backoff properly so they retried aggressively and hit write timeouts. Logs: ```error=write_timeout, job_id=abc123, attempts=7```
Ravi P (Product Ops): Confirming — config change was intended for ingress spikes but the window size was too small. We should revert the limiter and deploy a fix to the retry backoff within the next 2 hours. Ops timeline: revert is low risk, patch needs canary then prod.
Marta L (Solutions): For the immediate customer comms we should: 1) acknowledge impact, 2) list mitigation (manual replay + credits + office hours), 3) give ETA for fix and RCA date. Keep it short.
Priya S (CS): Draft status note for customers below — any edits?
Priya S (CS): ```Hi — we’re reaching out because some onboarding and indexing jobs experienced delays overnight. What happened: a new internal rate-limiter configuration unintentionally throttled background reindex jobs, which caused retries and write timeouts for a subset of tenants. What we’re doing now: we reverted the limiter to the prior setting (completed), manually replaying stuck jobs (in progress), and pushing a retry-backoff patch (ETA 2h). Customer impact: some trial activations and a small number of renewal demos may have been delayed; no data loss. Next update: we’ll provide an RCA within 48 hours and a completion note when all replays finish. If you want immediate help we’ll schedule a 30-min troubleshooting session. Apologies for the disruption — Priya on CS for contact.```
Jamal R (Account Exec): Add a line offering to reschedule demo slots and provide a short free extension on trials for impacted customers. For ACME/BlueShift, I'll call and offer a 1-week trial extension.
Elena K (Support): Also include a link to a short status page entry and an ops contact. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1748619999
Ravi P (Product Ops): Ops update: revert completed at 02:32 UTC, manual replay started 02:50 UTC. Replays currently at 68% throughput, estimated finish 04:30 UTC. Patch PR here: https://git.internal/pr/4521 (canary started).
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary deployment started by Ravi P at 03:05 UTC for patch/retry-backoff. Monitor channel: #eng-runtime-deploys
Marta L (Solutions): Customer-facing email looks good. Suggest we prepare an exec one-pager for ACME/BlueShift with the tech summary + offer (1-week extension + free reindex assistance). Priya, can you prepare and share in next 30m?
Priya S (CS): On it — will post the tailored one-pagers here. Draft for ACME below, feel free to edit:
Priya S (CS): ```ACME — quick note: we experienced a transient indexing delay affecting your staged uploads for the POC. Impact: uploads stalled, no data lost. Mitigation: manual replay in progress, we can prioritize your tenant to finish first; offer: 1-week trial extension + 2 hours of hands-on reindex assistance; next steps: we’ll confirm replay completion and propose new demo slots. Contact: Priya S (cs@redwood.example).```
Jamal R (Account Exec): Fine. I'll call ACME now.
Elena K (Support): After replays complete we should run a quick smoke validation: sample queries + embed counts. I can own that validation and post results.
Ravi P (Product Ops): Postmortem plan: 1) short timeline and impact (by tenant), 2) root cause analysis (rate limiter delta + retry bug), 3) corrective actions (revert, backoff fix, unit tests + deployment guard for limiter changes), 4) preventative monitoring (alert if background job success < 95%). RCA draft ETA: 48 hours.
Marta L (Solutions): Also capture renewal risk score for the 7 accounts and note any customers we should escalate to sales leadership.
Priya S (CS): Understood. I’ll compile the impacted tenant list and renewal risk notes and link to the RCA doc when ready. Posting finish/update checklist: - customer status note sent (template) - tailored exec one-pagers for high-risk renewals - replay validation (Elena) - credits/extensions applied - RCA document published
Elena K (Support): Validations: will post pass/fail per tenant once replays finish.
ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: incident_id=INC-2026-0421-01, severity=low-medium, owner=Priya S.
Priya S (CS): Thanks team. I'll send the first batch of customer emails in 10m and ping when ACME/BlueShift calls complete. :raised_hands:
